theme:ai-power.value: 2026-10-23 Bloom Energy reported Q3 on Oct 22: revenue $1.24 billion, up 138%, adjusted EPS $0.94 against about $0.69 expected, and a third raise of 2026 revenue guidance to $4.4 to $4.6 billion. But free cash flow was negative $181 million in the quarter, and the stock had already fallen 8.7% to 217.77 that day. Comfort Systems posted a record $17.81 billion backlog, up from $14.06 billion in June, yet fell about 5% after hours. GE Vernova fell 10.6% to 827.42 on 2.56x normal volume as Meta's spending stoked worries about how AI sites get financed.
theme:ai-power.was: 2026-10-20 Korea's LS Electric booked a $138.5 million order from Bloom Energy for 38 kV switchgear and transformers for Bloom fuel cells at a Pennsylvania data center, delivering April to July 2027 (DCD, Oct 2026). DCD says the site is likely Aligned's Project Phoenix campus at Shippingport, where Bloom may deploy up to 2 GW. The same week nuclear names kept falling: Barclays cut NuScale to Underweight and it hit a new 52 week low (24/7 Wall St, Oct 20), with Oklo down about 5%.

theme:robotics-automation.value: 2026-10-22 Tesla said on its Oct 21 call that Optimus production has started on high volume lines in Fremont, with Musk warning the early ramp will be slow and bumpy, and that it aims to deliver the first Cybercab robotaxis to customers by Dec 31 and launch in Dallas next month. It also cut 2026 capex to about $20 billion from more than $25 billion. Q3 adjusted EPS was $0.48 against about $0.43 expected, but the stock fell about 3% to 5% premarket.
theme:robotics-automation.was: 2026-10-13 XPeng set a timeline for its IRON humanoid at its Oct 12 Paris event: mass production by the end of 2026, deliveries in the first half of 2027, starting in stores and malls, and Europe later in 2027. Separately, a Wall Street Journal report says Walmart is still struggling to automate its US warehouses and that Symbotic does not expect a workable in store model until 2028.

theme:critical-materials.value: 2026-10-17 China's September rare earth exports rose 6.7% from a year ago to 4,269.8 tonnes, though January to September exports are still down 9.6% (SMM). On Oct 15 China's commerce ministry said it will keep easing rare earth export licenses for the EU and wants the same treatment on dual use cases. US producers fell: MP 3.5% to 40.17 and USAR 5.0% to 10.54 on Oct 16 (dashboard).
theme:critical-materials.was: 2026-10-16 Alcoa reported Q3 on Oct 15: adjusted EPS $1.82, revenue $3.7 billion (down from $3.97 billion in Q2 on lower metal prices), free cash flow $472 million, alumina output up 11% to 2.5 million tons, and the Alumar smelter in Brazil fully restarted. South32 holders approved the AliGroup deal, which Alcoa expects to close in the first half of 2027.

theme:defense-reshoring.value: 2026-10-22 Lockheed Martin reported Q3 on Oct 22: sales $20.7 billion, up from $18.6 billion, EPS $7.97 against about $7.50 expected, and a record $292.0 billion backlog that includes $52.5 billion from the multiyear PAC-3 MSE interceptor award. It raised 2026 guidance to sales of about $80 to $82 billion and EPS of $30.35 to $30.75, and raised its dividend for the 24th straight year. Interceptor replacement money is now locked in for years.
theme:defense-reshoring.was: 2026-10-21 Northrop Grumman reported Q3 on Oct 20: sales $11.1 billion, up 7%, EPS $7.89 against $7.18 expected, a record $109.6 billion backlog on a 1.5x book to bill, and a 2026 EPS guide raised to $29.35 to $29.75 from $28.60 to $29.10. The stock rose 4.57%. Management expects about 35% of the backlog to turn into revenue within 12 months.

theme:space-quantum-cyber.value: 2026-10-21 SpaceX reported Q3 on Oct 20: revenue $14.6 billion, up 161%, with its AI unit at $7.56 billion, more than half of sales, and net income of $4.4 billion; Q3 capital spending was $19.6 billion and Q4 is guided at $35 to $40 billion. Musk said SpaceX and Tesla boards formed special committees to explore a merger, with no terms and Musk not on either committee. SPCX rose about 4.8% after hours.
theme:space-quantum-cyber.was: 2026-10-17 Cybersecurity stocks broke on Oct 16: OKTA fell 10.2% to 187.26, S 7.7%, PANW 7.6% to 342.00, CRWD 7.0% to 227.39 and ZS 5.9% to 207.38 (dashboard). Bernstein cut Okta, Palo Alto and SentinelOne to Market Perform on valuation after a near 100% rally since early 2026, and reports of AI lab security products (Perplexity, and an OpenAI security acquisition reported Oct 14) added to the selling.

theme:healthcare-medtech.value: 2026-10-23 Leaked melanoma data on Oct 22 showed Moderna and Merck's personalized vaccine (intismeran) plus Keytruda cut the risk of recurrence or death by 42% against Keytruda alone; 82.2% of patients were alive and cancer free at two years against 70%. Overall survival is not yet mature. Moderna fell about 18% to 20% and Merck 1.8% in a sell the news move; full data comes Oct 24 in Madrid. On the same risk off day medtech rose: ISRG up 3.7% to 443.85, ZBH 4.2%, PODD 4.4%, MDT 3.8% (dashboard).
theme:healthcare-medtech.was: 2026-10-21 Intuitive beat on Oct 20 (revenue $3.05 billion, up 22%; adjusted EPS $3.00) but US da Vinci procedures grew only 10% against 20% abroad, it took a $450 million antitrust settlement charge, and it plans extended use instruments, volume pricing and China cuts that lower instrument revenue per procedure 3% to 5% by the end of 2027. It traded near $406 after hours from a 438.00 close. On Oct 21 Abbott matched estimates (adjusted EPS $1.42), cut 2026 comparable sales growth to about 6%, and said it will spin off its $8.5 billion Nutrition business by the end of 2027.

theme:ai-compute.value: 2026-10-23 The chip index fell 6.72% on Oct 22 to 10,731.98, its weakest close since July 29, with all 30 members down. Lam fell 11.8% after its CEO said clean room space and component shortages will limit chipmakers into 2027, and Nvidia's CEO said neocloud customers lack the working capital to fund their growth. Meta's 10-Q showed about $825 billion of future lease and contract commitments, up from about $700 billion in July, and its five year credit default swap hit a record.
theme:ai-compute.was: 2026-10-22 Meta narrowed 2026 capex to $135 to $145 billion from $130 to $145 billion, spent $34.9 billion in Q3 with about negative $2.1 billion of free cash flow, and gave no 2027 number (Oct 21). It will issue non voting Class C shares to help fund AI. Lam Research posted record revenue of $8.22 billion but guided December to $8.60 billion, plus or minus $400 million, only in line, citing supply limits and lower China sales; it fell about 7% to 8% overnight. The spending floor rose, but the biggest buyer is now cash negative, and investors sold every AI report.

theme:fintech-crypto-rails.value: 2026-10-23 American Express reported Q3 on Oct 23: record revenue of $20.1 billion, up 9%, GAAP EPS $5.42, adjusted EPS $4.68 against about $4.58 expected, billed business up 8% to $454.0 billion, and a higher 2026 EPS guide (company release).
theme:fintech-crypto-rails.was: 2026-10-16 Interactive Brokers reported Q3 on Oct 15: accounts up 35% to 5.58 million, customer equity up 27% to $964.7 billion, margin loans up 36% to $105.2 billion, and the quarterly dividend raised to $0.15 from $0.0875. Separately the SEC approved Cboe binary options tied to company metrics (Chair Atkins, Oct 13), covering more than 100 metrics at 23 companies; Robinhood is expected to offer them first, with no launch date set.

industry:agriculture-food.value: 2026-10-17 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Deere announced next generation perception autonomy kits in early October for tractors and tillage, orchard sprayers, and landscape and construction machines, and AGCO's Oct 6 Tech Day showed PTx retrofit autonomy for mixed fleets. Corteva set its first crop protection only report for Nov 11 after the close. Perfect Day now targets first commercial whey deliveries from India in Q1 2027. No stage moves: these are product launches, not new revenue.

industry:communications.value: 2026-10-16 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Ericsson's Q3 (Oct 15) showed sales of SEK 59.5 billion against 56.2 billion a year ago, 7% organic growth led by Networks, and net income down to about SEK 5.8 billion because last year included a divestment gain. It still sees a flat radio market in 2026 and rising AI driven component costs. The ERIC ADR jumped 11.8% to 10.71 on about 4.5 times normal volume. Amazon had almost 400 Leo satellites up as of Oct 9; AST has not yet dated its next launch.

industry:consumer.value: 2026-10-18 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Dexcom set Q3 results for Oct 29 after the close and Hims for Nov 9; Abbott reports Oct 21. The FDA panel on Sydnexis's SYD-101 myopia drop is still set for Oct 30, and Oura has not set a new IPO date since postponing on Sep 29. No stage moves: these are dates, not new revenue or approvals.

industry:defense-security.value: 2026-10-19 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Drone Dominance Gauntlet II orders have started (Neros 14,000 drones for over $100 million, Swarm Defense 4,000 for at least $25 million), the Army now expects its first LOCUST X3 laser by Q4 FY2027 and combat use by early 2028, and the Senate leader signaled no new Golden Dome reconciliation money before the midterms. No stage moves: orders are small next to the 60,000 drone plan.

industry:energy.value: 2026-10-23 Bloom Energy's Q3 (Oct 22) showed behind the meter power is selling: product revenue crossed $1 billion for the first time ($1.07 billion, up 179%), total revenue rose 138% to $1.24 billion, and 2026 revenue guidance rose to $4.4 to $4.6 billion. The catch is cash: the quarter used $181 million of free cash flow as inventory and receivables grew.
industry:energy.was: 2026-10-20 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Behind the meter power keeps adding real orders: LS Electric booked $138.5 million of switchgear for Bloom fuel cells at a Pennsylvania data center, likely Aligned's Project Phoenix where Bloom may supply up to 2 GW (DCD). Fervo's Cape Station is running and it is hosting an investor open house, while JPMorgan cut its target to $27 on Oct 19. Small reactor stocks hit new lows on a Barclays downgrade of NuScale (Oct 20). No stage moves.

industry:financials.value: 2026-10-13 Morgan Stanley moved its target for tokenized stock trading on its alternative trading system to Q1 2027 from the second half of 2026 (said Oct 12 at TOKEN2049), citing market plumbing, products and rules that still need time. It still sees tokenized real world assets reaching $3 to $10 trillion by 2030, against about $39 to $40 billion today.
industry:financials.was: 2026-10-12 Treasury issued its first GENIUS Act rule (an interim final rule reported Sep 30): stablecoin issuers above $10 billion must move to the federal framework within 360 days unless waived, which shuts the state route for Tether and Circle. The OCC says its own final rule is targeted for November.

industry:healthcare.value: 2026-10-21 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Intuitive's Q3 (Oct 20) showed revenue of $3.05 billion, up 22%, and about 14% da Vinci procedure growth, but US procedures grew only 10% against 20% abroad. It plans extended use instruments and other price moves that cut instrument revenue per case 3% to 5% by the end of 2027, and took a $450 million antitrust settlement charge. The stock traded near $406 after hours from 438.00. Gene editing (lonvo-z decision March 10, 2027), AI diagnostics (Medicare fee schedule final rule due early November) and brain implants had no new milestone; no FDA action on CagriSema has been reported.
industry:healthcare.was: 2026-10-11 FDA accepted Intellia's lonvo-z filing with priority review and set a March 10, 2027 decision date, with no advisory panel planned. The first in vivo CRISPR approval now has a date, and chronic HAE drug makers have a clock on them.

industry:industrials.value: 2026-10-13 Symbotic announced on Oct 13 that it is buying cellumation, a Bremen sortation company whose software driven floor replaces fixed conveyors. At the same time a Wall Street Journal report says Walmart's warehouse automation keeps hitting breakdowns and that Symbotic does not expect a workable in store pickup model until 2028, which pushes out the 400 store option.

industry:materials.value: 2026-10-14 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Hexcel confirmed it will report Q3 results on Oct 21 after the close, with the call Oct 22; third party calendars showing Oct 26 or Oct 28 are wrong. MP Materials still guides first commercial magnet shipments to GM for Q4 2026, with no shipment date announced.

industry:space.value: 2026-10-15 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Starship Flight 14 (Sep 28) was the first to reach orbit and deployed all 26 Starlink V3 satellites, though a vacuum engine failed and the stay in orbit was cut short; Flight 15 is penciled for no earlier than Oct 19 but not confirmed. SpaceX was reported Oct 6 to 7 to be seeking about $40 billion of debt to buy Nvidia chips. Planet Labs stock is down about 66% from its May peak even with record revenue, as money rotates to SpaceX and rates rise.

industry:technology.value: 2026-10-22 Meta narrowed 2026 capex to $135 to $145 billion but gave no 2027 number and had about negative $2.1 billion of free cash flow in Q3 (Oct 21). The inference build is still growing, but the biggest buyer now spends more than it earns, so 2027 budgets are the test.
industry:technology.was: 2026-10-12 IonQ agreed to buy Elisity, a zero trust network security company, for up to $1.3 billion in stock (reported Oct 12). It is a revenue and product grab, not a quantum milestone, and it adds dilution.

industry:transportation.value: 2026-10-23 Rechecked on the daily rotation. On its Oct 21 call Tesla said its Austin Cybercab fleet grew about 10 times since the early September launch, neared 2 million cumulative unsupervised miles, and should reach Dallas next month, with first customer Cybercab deliveries targeted by end of 2026. It also cut 2026 capex to about $20 billion. The FAA drone rule (Part 108) is still at White House review past its Oct 8 window, and neither Joby nor Archer has confirmed a paying passenger.
industry:transportation.was: 2026-10-12 Waymo closed a $5 billion term loan, upsized from about $3 billion and priced at 5.25 points over the benchmark rate, to expand its fleet in the US and abroad. Lenders funding robotaxis is a sign the business is moving from research to fleet operations.

country:argentina.value: 2026-10-23 Argentina's country risk rose to 709 points on Oct 22 and the official dollar sold at a nominal record 1,550 pesos at Banco Nacion (wholesale 1,528), while the Merval fell 1.5% to 97,993 as the tech sell off hit ADRs (Rio Times).
country:argentina.was: 2026-10-17 Pampa Energia director and 10% owner Marcos Mindlin bought about $35.1 million of PAM ADRs at $80.78 on Oct 15 (filed Oct 16), on top of buys by two vice presidents in late September; the insider cluster is about $42.7 million. PAM closed at 81.10 on Oct 16, up 0.8% (dashboard).

country:brazil.value: 2026-10-23 Final polls before the Oct 25 runoff show a dead heat: Datafolha has Flavio Bolsonaro and Lula at 50% each of valid votes (released Oct 22, down from 51% to 49% a week earlier), and PoderData has Flavio at 51% to 49% (released Oct 22, down from a 4 point lead). Markets have priced a Bolsonaro win, so a Lula win is the bigger surprise.
country:brazil.was: 2026-10-22 Quaest's runoff poll released Oct 21 has Flavio Bolsonaro at 45% and Lula at 44%, down from 46% to 44% on Oct 14 (Reuters). With four days to go, the race is within one point, while markets have priced a Bolsonaro win.

country:china.value: 2026-10-22 China's CSI 300 entered a bear market on Oct 22, closing 20.2% below its June 22 peak after 10 straight weekly losses, its first since 2020. Analysts pointed to doubts about AI returns and a deadline on Beijing's push to tax offshore trusts, which may have pushed some large holders to sell.
country:china.was: 2026-10-20 On Oct 16 China made companies register before exporting a list of AI, biotech and solar technologies, effective at once, and proposed banning exports of 12 solar manufacturing methods, including advanced wafer, perovskite and tandem cell know how (pv magazine, Geopolitechs). Finished panels are not covered. Public comment runs to Nov 15.

country:europe.value: 2026-10-22 France's 10 year yield touched 5% on Oct 21, up 8 basis points on the day and its highest since 2002, and rose to about 5.10% on Oct 22 as unrest and the stalled budget weighed. The gap over German bonds is near its widest since 2011. Moody's reviews France's Aa3 negative rating on Oct 23.
country:europe.was: 2026-10-21 France's National Assembly set the revenue vote on the 2027 budget for Nov 3 instead of Oct 20 (TokenPost, Oct 20), so Moody's reviews France's Aa3 negative rating on Oct 23 with no budget passed. The prime minister promised more curfews after the worst unrest in years, and the CAC 40 fell 0.38% to 7,838.49 with French 10 year yields near a 24 year high.

country:gulf.value: 2026-10-23 Brent settled up about 4% at $113.17 on Oct 22, its highest close since May 4, and WTI rose 2.4% to $99.47, after the Saudi attacks and the US order for some diplomats to leave (Bloomberg via Rigzone). Kpler reported Hormuz flows near prewar levels, so this is a risk premium. SLB said on Oct 23 its Middle East revenue rose 13% from Q2.
country:gulf.was: 2026-10-22 A Houthi drone strike on Saudi Aramco's Shaybah oil field killed two people but did not affect operations, a separate attack on King Fahd International Airport in Dammam killed one, and the US ordered some embassy staff and families to leave Saudi Arabia (Bloomberg, Oct 22). Brent settled at $108.82 on Oct 21 and rose as much as 3.3% to $112.43 early Oct 22. Trump denied the US is negotiating with Iran; Iran says indirect talks continue via Pakistan and Qatar.

country:india.value: 2026-10-19 On Oct 16 Trump waived the Graham Act's tariffs of up to 100% on the top five buyers of Russian crude, two days before they took effect. India is one of the largest buyers, so the threat of a new US tariff on top of the 10% Section 301 rate is gone for now, and Brent fell about 2% to $107.60 on Oct 19, which helps an oil importer.
country:india.was: 2026-10-16 India's September consumer prices rose 5.54% from a year ago, up from 4.83% in August, with food up 7.74% (MoSPI, Oct 12). Inflation is now above the RBI's own 5.2% forecast, which backs its Oct 7 hike and keeps another one possible.

country:japan.value: 2026-10-23 The Nikkei fell about 2.7% on Oct 22 as Tokyo Electron, SoftBank Group and Kioxia were sold with US chips, then slipped 0.34% to 62,693.16 on Oct 23, down from 64,621.24 on Oct 21 (CNBC).
country:japan.was: 2026-10-21 The Nikkei fell 1.30% to 64,075.42 on Oct 20 as SoftBank and chip suppliers sold off, then rose 0.85% to 64,621.24 on Oct 21, with Advantest up about 5.3% and Tokyo Electron about 3.0%, after Super Micro and SpaceX results. A 20 year JGB auction drew record demand on Oct 20.

country:mexico.value: 2026-10-13 The peso rebounded 0.73% to about 18.26 per dollar on Oct 12 after last week's slide to its weakest since November 2025. September inflation rose to 3.45% a year from 3.26%, a bit under the 3.47% forecast. Banxico's next decision is Nov 5 at 6.50%.
country:mexico.was: 2026-10-09 The peso slid to about 18.41 per dollar, its weakest since November 2025, as the carry trade unwound. That hurts dollar earnings of Mexican companies and helps exporters and tourism.

country:south-korea.value: 2026-10-23 SK hynix halted the review of a pre IPO round and Nasdaq listing for its US NAND unit Solidigm, easing worries about a duplicate listing; the stock rose about 4.4% and lifted the KOSPI 0.30% to 5,550.30 on Oct 23 after an early 2.36% drop. Foreign investors were net sellers of 994.1 billion won. SK hynix reports Q3 before 9am Seoul time on Oct 28, which is 8pm ET on Oct 27.
country:south-korea.was: 2026-10-22 The Bank of Korea held its rate at 3.00% on Oct 22 in a 7 to 0 vote but signaled more tightening, saying the timing of further hikes depends on Q3 GDP and inflation. The KOSPI fell 3.52% to 5,533.77, its lowest close since April, wiping out Oct 21's rebound as chip stocks sold off with US AI names.

country:taiwan.value: 2026-10-23 The Taiex fell 846.34 points, or 1.81%, to 46,041.43 on Oct 22 as US chip stocks fell 6.72%. Taipei's market was closed on Oct 23 for Typhoon Champi, so local stocks will catch up with two days of US moves on Monday.
country:taiwan.was: 2026-10-21 The Taiex fell 1.13% on Oct 20, then rose 594.84 points, or 1.28%, to 46,887.77 on Oct 21, led by AI server makers after Super Micro raised its September quarter revenue outlook to $18.5 to $19.5 billion (Focus Taiwan).
